items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: We had a baby, Bayshake, Sidney Bayshake. ... Sidney would come on that old smoky... train... He'd know he had to play the picnic.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Was it a pic on that same gap with you, Willie?
No, we had, we had, he's dead now. We had a baby, Bayshake, Sidney Bayshake. Oh, yeah.
